rule: Wording and F4 rules of the FinOps IQ v3 value model (DESIGN.md section 10). Numbers here are LTM heuristics registered in registry/assumptions.json; published maxima, ranges, ramps and effort come from registry/levers.json. Nothing here is a market fact.

labels.headline: Indicative value range: not a savings commitment; evidence validation required
labels.detail: Conservative, expected and upper cases, net of estimated internal implementation effort and tooling. External support is not included.
labels.withheld: No value figure is shown without your internal cost rate per FTE-month: net value cannot be computed without it. The levers below show what would be quantified.
labels.notQuantifiedAtAll: No lever can be quantified from the inputs given; the levers below show what would quantify them.

scoring.rule: The uplift and the need modifier use only figures the report shows, at the client's own answers: a lever's expected net run-rate as a share of its comparison base, and the expected public cloud value as a share of P. Without a shown figure (no internal rate, or the lever not quantified) neither applies.

comparisonBases.cloud: in-scope public cloud spend (P, at the midpoints)
comparisonBases.saasLicensing: SaaS and licensing spend in scope
comparisonBases.totalInScope: total in-scope spend (SaaS or licensing spend not given)

finopsTeam.statement: Cost of an accountable FinOps lead or team, shown beside the value as its own decision (DECISION-01). It is not netted against the levers, because it also enables levers that are not yet quantified.
finopsTeam.notRaised: Not shown: the answers show an accountable owner for cloud spend already.
finopsTeam.noRate: Not shown: needs your internal cost rate per FTE-month.

costs.toolingNotProvided: Tooling cost not provided: net figures exclude it.
costs.toolingProvided: Tooling cost as you provided it.
costs.externalSupport: External support is not included: net covers internal effort and tooling only (Q10).

reasons.evidence: Every input is provider-tool or measured evidence no older than 90 days
reasons.exact: Every input is an exact client figure
reasons.band: At least one input is a band
reasons.derived: The scheduled share is derived from the OP-06 answer

notQuantifiedReasons.executive_mode: Quantified in the workshop: executive mode quantifies commitments (LEV-01) and scheduling (LEV-04) only
notQuantifiedReasons.not_quantified_in_v1: Identified, not quantified in this version: it needs architecture discovery
notQuantifiedReasons.rate_unsourced_for_provider: Not quantified for {providers}: no published maximum has been read from the provider yet
notQuantifiedReasons.no_estimate_of_type: Identified, not quantified: the provider-tool export has no {types} estimate
notQuantifiedReasons.evidence_needs_assessment_date: Identified, not quantified: the assessment date is needed to check the age of the provider-tool export
notQuantifiedReasons.evidence_older_than_90_days: Identified, not quantified: the provider-tool export is more than 90 days old
notQuantifiedReasons.public_cloud_spend_unknown: Identified, not quantified: in-scope public cloud spend is needed for every public cloud lever and for the global cap

zero.title: {lever}: no further value at today's inputs
zero.consequence: At the inputs given, this lever adds nothing once the levers before it in the sequence are applied.
zero.action: Keep the current practice and re-check the inputs at the next review

LEV-01.title: Commitment discounts: indicative value on steady compute not yet covered
LEV-01.consequence: Steady compute that is not covered by commitments is paid at on-demand rates.
LEV-01.action: Buy commitments in staged tranches on the steady usage left after the usage levers, and track coverage and utilisation monthly
LEV-01.zeroTitle: Commitment discounts: no further commitments until usage changes land
LEV-01.zeroConsequence: Today's coverage already meets the steady usage that remains once unscheduled non-production and Spot-movable usage are taken out; buying more now would commit to usage the plan removes.
LEV-01.zeroAction: Do not buy further commitments until scheduling and other usage changes land; re-baseline coverage then
LEV-01.evidence: Commitment coverage and utilisation reports for the last 3 months, by provider.
LEV-01.overCoverage: Coverage is above the steady usage that remains: review commitment renewals and exchanges before buying more.

LEV-02.title: Rightsizing and modernisation: indicative value from your provider-tool estimate
LEV-02.consequence: Over-sized resources are paid for at full rate every hour they run.
LEV-02.action: Work through the provider-tool rightsizing recommendations with the owning teams, with performance guardrails
LEV-02.evidence: Provider-tool rightsizing export no older than 90 days, deduplicated across recommendation types.

LEV-03.title: Idle and orphaned resources: indicative value from your provider-tool estimate
LEV-03.consequence: Idle and orphaned resources cost money and deliver nothing.
LEV-03.action: Remove or stop the idle and orphaned resources the provider tools identify, with owner sign-off
LEV-03.evidence: Provider-tool idle-resource export no older than 90 days.

LEV-04.title: Non-production scheduling: indicative value from switching non-production off outside working hours
LEV-04.consequence: Non-production compute that runs around the clock is paid for during hours nobody uses it.
LEV-04.action: Set a default schedule on non-production compute, with approved exceptions
LEV-04.evidence: Inventory of non-production compute by environment tag, with current schedules.

LEV-05.title: Storage tiering and lifecycle: indicative value from your provider-tool estimate
LEV-05.consequence: Rarely accessed data held in the hot tier is paid at the highest storage price.
LEV-05.action: Apply lifecycle rules to move rarely accessed data to cooler tiers or delete it
LEV-05.evidence: Provider storage analytics or provider-tool storage export no older than 90 days.

LEV-06.title: Spot and preemptible capacity: indicative value on interruption-tolerant compute
LEV-06.consequence: Interruption-tolerant workloads such as batch and CI run at on-demand rates.
LEV-06.action: Move interruption-tolerant workloads to Spot or preemptible capacity with interruption handling
LEV-06.evidence: List of batch, CI and stateless workloads with their interruption tolerance.

LEV-07.title: Kubernetes efficiency: indicative value from requests set above measured use
LEV-07.consequence: Cluster nodes are sized for requested, not used, CPU and memory.
LEV-07.action: Set requests from measured use and let the node autoscaler consolidate under-used nodes
LEV-07.evidence: Cluster cost allocation and measured used-versus-requested CPU and memory, last 30 days.

LEV-08.title: Data transfer: identified, not quantified
LEV-08.consequence: Data transfer cost depends on architecture and is not visible without discovery.
LEV-08.action: Review data transfer paths in an architecture review
LEV-08.evidence: Data transfer cost by service and path, last 3 months.

LEV-09.title: SaaS and licensing: indicative value from measured unused licences and seats
LEV-09.consequence: Unused licences and seats are paid for until the contract renews.
LEV-09.action: Remove or re-harvest unused licences and seats at each renewal
LEV-09.evidence: SaaS management or licence usage report with renewal dates.

LEV-10.title: AI and GPU: indicative value from idle endpoints and GPU utilisation
LEV-10.consequence: Idle model endpoints and under-used GPUs are among the most expensive resources in the estate.
LEV-10.action: Remove idle endpoints and consolidate GPU workloads towards the target utilisation
LEV-10.evidence: GPU utilisation and endpoint traffic metrics, last 30 days.

excluded.title: {lever}: not worth pursuing at this scale
excluded.action: Do not start this lever now; re-check it when spend or the inputs change

leverFindings.overCoverageTitle: Commitment coverage above steady usage: stop buying commitments

scopeConfirmation.title: Confirm {input}
scopeConfirmation.consequence: Without {input}, {levers} cannot be quantified, so the value range leaves {them} out.
scopeConfirmation.action: Confirm {input} ({question}) with evidence, then re-run the value range
scopeConfirmation.evidence: {input}, from billing data or provider reports.

decision02.title: Sequence commitments after scheduling and Spot moves
decision02.consequence: Steady usage exceeds today's commitment coverage, but the scheduling and Spot moves in the plan remove all of it; commitments bought now would lock in usage the plan removes.
decision02.action: Agree the sequence: scheduling and Spot moves first, then re-baseline commitment coverage on the usage that remains
decision02.evidence: Commitment coverage and utilisation reports, and the scheduling and Spot plan with dates.

explanations.levers_not_quantified: Some levers are identified but not quantified; the evidence listed with them would quantify them.
explanations.expected_is_half_of_maximum: The model's expected case is deliberately half of its technical maximum.
explanations.unallocated_not_waste: Your estimate may include unallocated spend, which is not waste.
explanations.estimate_at_or_below_model: Your estimate is at or below the model's expected case; the model rests on the shares and evidence you gave, which validation would confirm.

hypothesis.statement: Your own estimate, shown beside the model for comparison. It is never an input and changes no number.

ramp.rule: Year-N share = the lever's ramp share x the share of year N left after the month its owning finding starts.

headline.rule: Only levers whose expected net 3-year value, at the margin, is above zero count in the headline; the others are shown as not worth pursuing at this scale, with their figures, and are left out of the totals.
headline.excludedText: Not worth pursuing at this scale: at the margin its expected 3-year value does not exceed its estimated effort, so it is left out of the headline.

spend.banded: In-scope public cloud spend is a band; each case uses the band corner that gives its value, so its percentage is of that corner's spend.
spend.exact: In-scope public cloud spend as given.
